apis.name: Accounts API
apis.audience: Internal apps, corporate clients, licensed data aggregators
apis.summary: Returns deposit, card and loan account details, balances and account holders for an authenticated customer or corporate client. Source of truth for account balances displayed in the mobile app and online banking.
endpoints: List accounts the caller is entitled to view, with pagination.
Retrieve account details (type, status, open date, product code).
Current, available and ledger balances, with as-of timestamp.
Account holders and authorised signers (masked PII).
changelog: v3.4 (2026-03): added holds field to balances response

apis.name: Transactions API
apis.audience: Internal apps, corporate clients, data aggregators, Fraud Strategy
apis.summary: Provides posted and pending transactions with merchant enrichment (category, merchant name, location) for deposit and card accounts, up to 24 months of history.
downstream: Fraud Risk Signals API (API-08) feature store
endpoints: List transactions with date range, status and amount filters.
Retrieve a single transaction with enrichment.
Full-text and structured search across a customer's accounts.

apis.name: Payments Initiation API
apis.audience: Corporate clients, ERP connectors, internal treasury applications
apis.summary: Initiates ACH, book transfer and check payments individually or in bulk files, with ISO 20022 structured remittance. All payments are screened by sanctions and the Fraud Risk Signals API before release.
apis.rate: 300 requests/minute per client; bulk files up to 50,000 items
endpoints: Create a single payment; requires Idempotency-Key header.
Upload a bulk payment file (ISO 20022 pain.001 or CSV).
Retrieve status: received, screened, released, settled, returned.

apis.name: Real-Time Payments API
apis.audience: Corporate and small-business clients, consumer app (P2P)
apis.summary: Sends and receives instant, irrevocable account-to-account payments 24x7x365 over real-time payment networks, including request-for-payment messages. Volumes grew 64% year-on-year in 2Q26.
apis.rate: 600 requests/minute per client; max $1,000,000 per payment
downstream: Treasury Liquidity Positions API (API-15) intraday cash
endpoints: Send a request for payment to a payer.
Check whether a receiving bank is reachable on the network.

apis.name: Wire Transfer API
apis.summary: Initiates domestic (Fedwire) and cross-border (SWIFT MT/ISO 20022 MX) wires with FX conversion using rates from the FX Rates API. Supports payment tracking via UETR.
endpoints: Create a domestic or international wire.
Get an FX quote valid for 60 seconds for a cross-currency wire.

apis.name: Card Management API
apis.audience: Mobile app, fintech and co-brand partners
apis.summary: Manages debit and credit card lifecycle: issuance, activation, lock/unlock, spend controls, digital wallet provisioning and replacement. PAN data is tokenized; raw card numbers are never returned.
endpoints: Set merchant-category, geography and amount controls.

apis.name: Customer Identity & KYC API
apis.summary: Performs identity verification, customer due diligence and beneficial-ownership checks, returning a KYC status and risk rating used to gate account opening and payment limits.
endpoints: Start an individual or entity verification.
Result: verified, review, rejected; with reason codes.
Current AML risk rating (low, medium, high).

apis.name: Fraud Risk Signals API
apis.audience: Card authorization, Payments, RTP, Wires, Credit Decisioning (internal only)
apis.summary: Returns real-time fraud scores (0-1) and reason codes for card authorizations, payments and account events using gradient-boosted and graph-based models. Average decision latency under 35 ms.
endpoints: Score an event (authorization, payment, login, account change).
Report confirmed fraud or false positive for model retraining.
changelog: v4.0 (2025-12): graph features; new reason codes

apis.name: Credit Decisioning API
apis.audience: Card, Auto and small-business origination channels; point-of-sale partners (sandbox)
apis.summary: Returns approve/decline/refer decisions, credit line and pricing tier for consumer and small-business credit applications, combining bureau attributes, internal behaviour scores and fraud signals. Decisions are logged for fair-lending monitoring and adverse-action notices.
endpoints: Submit an application and receive a decision.
Retrieve decision, reason codes and offered terms.

apis.name: Credit Risk Scoring API
apis.audience: Internal only: CECL model (MDL-CR-007), regulatory capital calculators, portfolio monitoring
apis.summary: Serves pool-level and obligor-level probability of default (PD), loss given default (LGD) and exposure at default (EAD) parameters. Provides point-in-time, scenario-conditional parameters for CECL and through-the-cycle parameters for Advanced approaches capital through separate endpoints. Designated a critical data service under BCBS 239.
apis.rate: 60 requests/minute; batch extracts via async jobs
apis.slo: 99.95% availability; quarterly refresh within T+3 business days
downstream: MDL-CR-007 CECL Lifetime Expected Credit Loss Model (CECL_Allowance_Model.xlsx)
endpoints: List portfolio pools (e.g. Credit Card, Residential Mortgage, CRE, C&I).
Point-in-time PD, LGD, remaining life and macro elasticities used by CECL.
Start an asynchronous full-portfolio extract; returns jobId.
changelog: v3.0 (2025-10): separate PIT/TTC endpoints; added macro elasticities used by MDL-CR-007

apis.name: Loan Servicing API
apis.audience: Servicing applications, CECL and ALM models, customer channels
apis.summary: Provides loan-level balances, payment schedules, delinquency status, remaining contractual life and repricing terms for consumer and wholesale loans; supports payoff quotes and payment posting.
apis.rate: 900 requests/minute; portfolio snapshots via async extract
upstream: Loan servicing systems (mortgage, auto, card, commercial)
endpoints: Loan details: balance, rate, next reset date, maturity, status.
Month-end portfolio snapshot aggregated by segment and repricing bucket (0-3m, 3-12m, 1-5y, >5y).

apis.name: Market Data API
apis.audience: Trading, risk, valuation control, Treasury/CIO models
apis.summary: Publishes end-of-day and intraday prices, yield curves (SOFR, Treasury), credit spreads and volatility surfaces from licensed vendors and internal marks. Golden source for VaR, fair value and the policy rate used in ALM models.
upstream: Internal trader marks (validated by Valuation Control)
downstream: MDL-ALM-014 NII Sensitivity Model (policy rate, curves)
endpoints: Yield curve points for a date (e.g. USD-SOFR, UST).

apis.name: FX Rates API
apis.audience: Wires, card cross-border pricing, risk aggregation, finance
apis.summary: Provides spot, forward and end-of-day reference FX rates for 150+ currency pairs, and executable quotes for client payments.
endpoints: Spot mid rates for currency pairs.
End-of-day reference rates used for financial reporting.
Executable quote for a client conversion.
changelog: v2.4 (2025-11): EOD reference endpoint for finance

apis.name: Macroeconomic Scenario API
apis.audience: Internal only: CECL, capital planning, stress testing, ALM
apis.summary: Distributes approved macroeconomic scenario sets (paths for unemployment, GDP, house prices, CRE prices, rates, spreads) and their probability weights. Scenario sets are versioned and locked after Scenario Committee approval. Migrated to the strategic data platform in 2Q26, cutting load time from six hours to under forty minutes.
apis.slo: 99.9% availability; new set published within 1 business day of approval
downstream: MDL-CR-007 CECL model (scenario weights, unemployment, HPI, CRE)
MDL-CAP-003 Capital Planning & Stress Projection Model
endpoints: Quarterly path for a variable in each scenario.

apis.name: Treasury Liquidity Positions API
apis.audience: Internal only: Treasury/CIO, liquidity risk, ALM and capital models
apis.summary: Aggregates intraday and end-of-day cash, collateral, HQLA and rate-sensitive balance sheet positions by legal entity, including yields and costs by product line. Feeds LCR/NSFR calculators and ALM models.
endpoints: Rate-sensitive positions with balance, yield/cost and duration by line.
HQLA by level and legal entity.
Intraday cash position by currency and entity.

apis.name: Regulatory Reporting API
apis.audience: Internal only: Regulatory Reporting, Capital Management, Disclosure Committee
apis.summary: Provides governed regulatory capital, RWA, leverage exposure and report line items (FR Y-9C, FFIEC 101, FR Y-15), reconciled to the general ledger at legal-entity level. Golden source for Pillar 3.
apis.slo: 99.9% availability; quarter-end data locked by day 25
downstream: MDL-CAP-003 Capital Planning & Stress Projection Model (starting CET1, RWA)
endpoints: CET1, Tier 1, Total capital and deductions.
RWA by exposure type and approach.
Total leverage exposure components and SLR.
Line items for a regulatory report schedule.

apis.name: Statements & Documents API
apis.audience: Mobile app, online banking, corporate clients
apis.summary: Lists and retrieves account statements, tax forms and notices as PDF, with e-delivery preferences.

apis.name: Webhooks & Event Notifications API
apis.summary: Lets clients subscribe to signed event notifications (payment status changes, card controls updated, statement available) delivered via HTTPS webhooks with retries and replay.
apis.rate: 100 subscription changes/hour; delivery up to 10,000 events/second
endpoints: Create a webhook subscription for event types.

errors: Malformed body, missing required field or invalid parameter value.
Missing, expired or invalid OAuth 2.0 access token.
Token lacks the scope required for this operation.
Resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.
Idempotency key reused with a different payload, or state conflict.
Rate limit exceeded; retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.
Unexpected server error; safe to retry idempotent requests with backoff.
Planned maintenance or dependency outage; see status page.

models.name: Net Interest Income Sensitivity Model
models.purpose: Projects 12-month net interest income under parallel rate shocks and economic value of equity (EVE) sensitivity for IRRBB reporting.
reports: Pillar 3 - Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book

models.name: CECL Lifetime Expected Credit Loss Model
models.owner: Consumer & Wholesale Credit Risk - Allowance Methodology
models.purpose: Estimates the allowance for credit losses under ASC 326 (CECL) using probability-weighted macroeconomic scenarios and PD x LGD x EAD.
reports: Annual Report - Allowance for Credit Losses (Note 6)

models.name: Capital Planning & Stress Projection Model
models.purpose: Projects CET1 capital, RWA and capital ratios over a nine-quarter horizon under baseline and severely adverse scenarios to size distributions.
reports: Pillar 3 - Capital Planning and Stress Testing
